transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I'm mostly here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining things. But I know I'm not. 

It's... my wife's relative. He's been coming into the house to get at me. I know where I leave my things, and my tools don’t just move themselves. And... my fishing plans. They don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. 

It's been going on for months now. I can see it plain as day, he’s... he's just trying to take over my place. Push me out. But nobody wants to listen to me about it.
Have you ever actually seen your wife’s relative inside the house when these things happened?
Not exactly. I mean... I haven't caught him right in the act, if that's what you're asking. He's careful. But I don't need to see him standing there to know he was in my house.
How certain are you that your wife’s relative is the one doing this?

I'm... I'm completely certain. I don't see who else it would be. Like I said before, I know where I put my tools. They just... move. And the fishing trips. It's too much of a coincidence. He wants me gone. I know it. I just... I know it.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?
No. Nothing like that. Just... what I already told you.
Have you had any recent head injury, seizure, or other serious medical illness?
No. I haven't been sick. My head is fine.
Do you believe your wife’s relative has any unusual or supernatural way of getting into your house or moving your things?
No... nothing like that. I don't know exactly how he gets inside. He just... does. Probably made a copy of a key or something. I don't know.
Have you noticed yourself becoming less interested in being around other people?
No. Not really. I just... go to work, do my job. Same as always, I guess.
If your wife showed you clear proof that her relative had not been in the house, would you believe it?

No. Because... look, everybody keeps acting like I'm just imagining it. But I know he's coming into the house to get at me. 

My tools don't just move themselves. And my fishing plans... they don't get spoiled by accident every single weekend. It's been months of this. I can see plain as day he's trying to take over my place. Push me out. 

So... no. I know what I see.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts are hard to follow or seem jumbled?
No. People understand me fine. I just... I don't talk all that much anyway. But when I do, nobody says it's jumbled.
During this time, have you had a period where you felt unusually high or energetic?
No. I don't get... high or whatever you're calling it. I just work. Nothing unusual.
Have you found yourself feeling emotionally flat or unable to show much feeling lately?
No. I feel fine. I just... I get frustrated with him messing with my stuff, that's all. But I'm not... flat.
Have you heard voices talking about you or commenting on what you’re doing?
No. I don't hear voices. It's just... it's just him, moving my things around. That's real, not in my head.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind that were not your own?
No. My thoughts are... they're mine. Nobody's putting anything in my head.
How long have you been certain that your wife’s relative has been coming into your house and interfering with your things?
About nine months. Just... ever since he moved into our home.
